Winter Art Week Supply List

Dear Grade 2 families,

Winter Art Week runs December 14 – 18. Please send the supplies below with your child on Monday, December 14. Everything should be in a labeled bag.

EventWinter Art Week
StartsMonday, December 14, 2026
Bring onMonday, December 14
ContactMr. Daniel Kim, Art Teacher, 02-000-0000

Supply list

  1. 1 box of colored pencils (12 count)
  2. 2 glue sticks
  3. 1 pair of child-safe scissors
  4. 1 old T-shirt to use as a paint smock
  5. 1 sketchbook, 8.5 x 11 inches
  6. Reusable water bottle

Notes

  • Write your child's name on every item.
  • Paint, brushes and paper are provided by the school.
  • If you cannot buy an item, email the art teacher and we will help.
